corpus.title: Microsoft Outlook 365 Crash Event 1000 Resolution Runbook
corpus.text:
Issue: Microsoft Outlook crashes immediately on launch with Event ID 1000 in Application log pointing to mso20win32client.dll.
Root Cause: Corrupted profile credential cache and outdated Office installation.
Resolution Steps:
1. Open Windows Credential Manager and clear all stored MicrosoftOffice16 credentials.
2. Run Quick Repair from Settings -> Apps -> Microsoft 365 Apps.
3. If failure persists, run Online Repair and verify registry key HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Outlook\Profiles.
4. Launch Outlook in safe mode (outlook.exe /safe) to disable suspect COM add-ins.
Approved Closure: Solution provided - Online Repair Executed.

corpus.title: Cisco AnyConnect VPN MTU and Tunnel Drop Troubleshooting
corpus.text:
Issue: Remote client Cisco AnyConnect VPN disconnects intermittently under heavy packet load.
Root Cause: Packet fragmentation over ISP PPPoE or fiber lines where standard 1500 byte MTU is rejected by upstream gateway.
Resolution Steps:
1. Check MTU sizing in AnyConnect client profile XML: set MTU to 1350.
2. In Windows command prompt (admin), run: netsh interface ipv4 set subinterface "Local Area Connection*" mtu=1350 store=persistent.
3. Verify DTLS tunnel negotiation on ASA/FTD headend.
4. Test continuous ping with don't fragment flag: ping -f -l 1322 internal-gateway.corp.
Approved Closure: Solution provided - MTU Adjusted.

corpus.title: Oracle Database Lock Contention and Index Fragmentation Runbook
corpus.text:
Issue: Production batch job stalling due to row-exclusive lock contention on transaction ledger tables.
Root Cause: Uncommitted distributed transactions and excessive index b-tree fragmentation exceeding 40%.
Resolution Steps:
1. Query gv$session and gv$locked_object to identify blocking SID and serial number.
2. Terminate orphaned sessions using ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION.
3. Rebuild fragmented indexes online using ALTER INDEX INV_LEDGER_PK REBUILD ONLINE.
4. Gather fresh table statistics with DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS.
Approved Closure: Solution provided - Index Rebuilt.

corpus.title: Wildcard SSL TLS Certificate Deployment on Fronting Load Balancers
corpus.text:
Issue: External portal shows NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID warning on *.domain.com.
Root Cause: Production wildcard SSL certificate expired before automated cert-manager renewal completed.
Resolution Steps:
1. Retrieve renewed DigiCert wildcard certificate (.crt and intermediate CA bundle) from corporate vault.
2. Log in to AWS ALB / F5 BIG-IP console and import new certificate keypair.
3. Bind new certificate to HTTPS listener port 443.
4. Verify TLS handshake and expiration using openssl s_client -connect app.domain.com:443 -servername app.domain.com.
Approved Closure: Solution provided - Certificate Renewed.

corpus.title: CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor Driver Lockup in Kernel Mode
corpus.text:
Issue: Windows endpoint experiences blue screen (BSOD) with csagent.sys stop code during boot.
Root Cause: Corrupted channel file or locked sensor kernel driver following partial update.
Resolution Steps:
1. Boot Windows endpoint into Safe Mode with Command Prompt.
2. Navigate to C:\Windows\System32\drivers\CrowdStrike.
3. Locate and delete C-00000291*.sys channel file or run CsUninstallTool with maintenance token.
4. Reboot normally and verify sensor connectivity in Falcon cloud console.
Approved Closure: Solution provided - Clean Driver Reinstalled.

corpus.title: Active Directory Account Lockout and Kerberos Ticket Purge
corpus.text:
Issue: User account repeatedly locks out every 5 minutes after password reset.
Root Cause: Cached credentials in Windows Credential Manager or mobile ActiveSync client continually attempting auth with old password.
Resolution Steps:
1. Run LockoutStatus.exe or query domain controller Event 4740 to pinpoint Caller Computer Name.
2. On source computer, clear Credential Manager Web and Windows Credentials.
3. Disconnect and re-authenticate cached Wi-Fi 802.1x profiles.
4. Purge Kerberos ticket cache using klist purge.
Approved Closure: Solution provided - Cached Credentials Cleared.

corpus.title: Windows Print Spooler Service Crash and Queue Clearing
corpus.text:
Issue: Network printer jobs queue indefinitely and Print Spooler service terminates with Event 7031.
Root Cause: Corrupted SPL or SHD file in spool directory holding an invalid EMF rendering thread.
Resolution Steps:
1. Open PowerShell as Admin and run: Stop-Service -Name Spooler -Force.
2. Navigate to C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS and remove all files in the directory.
3. Start service: Start-Service -Name Spooler.
4. Validate print driver isolation setting: Set-Printer -Name <Printer> -IsolateDriver $true.
Approved Closure: Solution provided - Spooler Cleaned.

corpus.title: ServiceNow Incident Lifecycle State Invariant Policy
corpus.text:
Policy Rule: Standard ITIL incident state sequence requires all incidents to enter state 'Resolved' (state 6) before advancing to 'Closed' (state 7).
Invariant Check: Moving directly from In-Progress (state 2) to Closed (state 7) without entering Resolved is a Critical Governance Compliance Failure (False Audit).
Penalty: Immediate score reduction to 0% on Activity Logs and overall audit flag.
Requirement: Incident must contain documented resolution notes, close code, and engineer verification before state transition.
